items.title: Weatherboard bach
items.description: A one-room New Zealand bach as a digital-twin-ready model: piled timber floor, painted weatherboard walls with real openings, a corrugate gable roof with rolled ridge, barge boards, fascia and spouting, timber joinery with glass, a front deck and steps, a wood-burner flue and a corrugated rainwater tank.
